symptom: A flow argument naming an enclosing data view that shows a page or snippet parameter (Item = $dvOuter) passes check and exec, then mx check reports CE0115 'The arguments that are passed to microflow ... do not match the expected parameters and need to be refreshed' on every button, container, list view data source and pluggable action using it; regression since v0.28
cause: classifyFlowArgValue returns kind 'widget' for any document widget (#1560, a grid's selection), and bindParameterMappingValue wrote PageVariable { Widget } alone; a data view showing a parameter needs the pair Widget + PageParameter/SnippetParameter. describe also read PageParameter before Widget, so a stored pair printed as $Item and the round trip dropped the widget
insight: The pair was already known: registerDataViewVariable records it for $dv.Attr text bindings (#826). When a kind covers two different things (a selection and a data view's object) the fix for one is the regression of the other; split on what the builder already recorded rather than adding a second classifier. The reporter's variant table settled it: dvMf (microflow-fed data view) passes Widget-only, so the pair is needed exactly when a parameter is behind the data view. Prove at mx check: same script, pre-fix binary 5 CE0115, fixed 0, and describe -> exec reports 'already in sync'.
